== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes will use this skill whenever it is charged, severely impacting the rest of their skill bar. Heroes will also not wait for conditions to be applied to the target or any targets adjacent to the user before using this skill, wasting its potential.

== Notes ==
* Unlike [[Earth Shaker]], which knocks down [[target]] foe and foes adjacent to the target, this attack hits foes adjacent to the user hence the attack can miss on kiting foes as with [[Cyclone Axe]] and [[Crude Swing]].
* Good synergy with [["You Are All Weaklings!"]] and [[Belly Smash]] (preceded by an [[elite]] knock-down, e.g. [[Earth Shaker]]).
* Skills like [[Withering Aura]] inflict conditions before Yeti Smash hits.
* In [[normal mode|normal]] and [[hard mode]], the [[AI]] will use this skill on a foe even if it is not adjacent to another foe nor suffering from a condition. <!--Tested with Koss in Isle of the Nameless and Jotun Skullsmasher-->

== Trivia ==
* [[Mountain Yeti]]s and [[Yeti (warrior)|Yetis]] are Warrior [[Yeti]]s in Factions that use Yeti Smash.
